cancellation.scope: APMS Premium SMS services on the original five-digit service code. Follow the provider instructions; not a universal command for app-store or other carrier-billed subscriptions.

premiumSms.limitation: Do not label every 9xxxx SMS premium. Match service type, full length and the listed ranges. Do not show a five-digit code as free. Billing category and individual transaction limits are different.

operatorLimitDiscrepancy.note: O2 states 999 CZK for an SMS/DMS transaction. APMS v5.6 states a 600 CZK supported MT price level. These are not the same limit; do not turn 600 into a universal safety guarantee.

premiumSms.priceLimitScope: APMS v5.6 section 3.3 supported Premium SMS price levels, including VAT; not an all-purpose legal limit for every carrier payment.

donorSms.note: This is the DMS project price menu, not a legal cap for all SMS. Check the project keyword in the official donor-project directory and operator support.

matchingNotes.note: Domestic voice prefixes apply to nine-digit national numbers. Normalize an explicit +420 or 00420 prefix before checking; keep international numbers separate.
Treat SMS short codes separately from nine-digit voice numbers. A 907 short code and a 907 voice prefix do not mean the same thing.
901–904 and 907 voice ranges are reserved in the numbering plan; do not apply a blanket 90x voice-price formula.
1180–1188 directory enquiries and 12/14 information lines can have extra charges without an encoded universal maximum. Do not label them free.
A country prefix, premium range, donor number or bank code alone must never produce a safe-or-fraud verdict. This is an application design rule based on the limited scope of the cited data.
